questions.question: What does David acknowledge about being righteous before God?
options: No one hiding can escape the eyes of God
No one living is righteous before God
No one trusting will be put to shame by God
No one seeking is turned away by God
questions.answer: No one living is righteous before God

questions.question: What does David ask God to teach him?
options: To rule the nations, for God is his king
To gain great wealth, for God is his portion
To do God's will, for God is his God
To win the battle, for God is his strength
questions.answer: To do God's will, for God is his God

questions.question: David asks to hear of God's steadfast love in the morning, for in God he trusts.
Teach me to do your _____, for you are my God!
Let me hear Your loving _____ in the morning, for in you I trust.
